title: package samplepkg
text: Package samplepkg is a fixture for the docs-generator parser tests. It deliberately mixes exported and unexported declarations so tests can verify that only exported symbols are reported.

title: User Guide
text: Write your own Markdown pages next to the generated API pages: pass their directory with --docs and docsgen copies them into the site, links them from the index, and adds them to search.json. Search works offline — search.json is a plain list of title, URL, and text entries, so any static host or tiny script can query it.
